versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Humanizer Academic English Edition.
- Detects and rewrites AI-generated patterns in academic English text.
- Preserves meaning, accuracy, disciplinary norms, and authorial voice.
- Includes a comprehensive pattern library targeting rhetorical inflation, word choice, sentence structure, transitions, attribution, formatting, and boilerplate.
- Focuses on natural academic prose by removing formulaic structures and restoring writer presence.
